subject: Request: Build-time controls package for SIG review
messages:
From: Sarah Kelly <sarah.kelly@cyceraudit.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up — build-time controls artifacts

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick intake call earlier. Acme's security team is consolidating SIG responses and they asked for our "build-time controls" evidence specifically:

- PR gating and code review policy excerpts (how we enforce reviews & approval counts)
- CI/CD pipeline snapshot showing who can trigger production deploys and which jobs are signed
- Artifact signing / provenance proof (how we record and verify built artifacts)
- Secrets handling for build agents (ephemeral creds, KMS/HSM usage, rotation cadence)
- Recent change-management tickets that touched deployment configs (last 90 days)

Can you drop a single package with named files for each item above? Tim Nash from Acme is copied for awareness. Ideally one PDF + a small CSV manifest and the CI YAML.

Deadline for the SIG pack is EOD Thursday (2026-06-10) — please let me know if that timeline works.

Thanks,
Sarah Kelly
Senior Assessor
CycerAudit

---
Attachments: none
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Kelly <sarah.kelly@cyceraudit.com>, Tim Nash <tim.nash@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — build-time controls artifacts

Sarah / Tim — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the requested items by EOD Thursday. I'll assemble a concise package that maps each artifact to the SIG question.

What I'll include:
- redwood_build_controls_v1.3.pdf (policy excerpts + screenshots of enforcement)
- ci_pipeline_snapshot_20260608.yaml (sanitized CI config showing gated jobs)
- artifact-signing-keys-summary.csv (key ids, signature tool, verification steps)
- secrets-rotation-audit-2026Q2.csv (recent rotations for build agents; sanitized usernames)
- changelog extract (JIRA export) referencing tickets that updated deploy pipelines

Laura — can you confirm the artifact signing summary and attach the JIRA extract? Monica — could you pull the secrets rotation CSV and drop the CI YAML (sanitized to remove internal service tokens)? I'll compile and send the single package to Sarah.

Rishi Malhotra

Rishi — I exported the JIRA tickets this morning. Attached: jf-changes-90d.csv (contains ticket id, summary, approver, date). Notes: two tickets in the last 90 days touched the deploy pipeline (INF-9382, INF-9421) — both had required approvals and automated integration tests.

Attachments: jf-changes-90d.csv, artifact-signing-keys-summary.csv
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai; Sarah Kelly <sarah.kelly@cyceraudit.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — build-time controls artifacts

Hi all — delivering the compiled package per Rishi's plan. Attached are the final artifacts and a short cover note mapping each file to the SIG control IDs. Summary highlights below and in the PDF:

- PR gating: All merges to main require 2 approvers; protected branch + CI gate prevents merges on failing tests. (See policy excerpt page 2 in PDF.)
- CI triggers: Only the CI service account can start prod-deploy jobs; human approval step enforced for manual promotion. (See ci_pipeline_snapshot_20260608.yaml, lines annotated.)
- Artifact provenance: Builds produce signed images and a signed SBOM; verification step is enforced as part of the deploy job. (artifact-signing-keys-summary.csv)
- Secrets: Build agents use ephemeral IAM tokens issued by our internal token broker; long-lived secrets are stored in customer-managed KMS for Private deployments. Rotation cadence for agents is 30 days; see secrets-rotation-audit-2026Q2.csv.
- Change mgmt: JIRA export lists deploy-pipeline configuration changes with approvers and links to the PRs.

Files attached: redwood_build_controls_v1.3.pdf; ci_pipeline_snapshot_20260608.yaml; artifact-signing-keys-summary.csv; secrets-rotation-audit-2026Q2.csv; jf-changes-90d.csv

If Sarah needs any redacted logs or a short demo video of the signing verification, I can produce that by Friday.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
